messages:
Anita R.: Heads-up — EdgeX (SI) asked to co-run a short livestream with Datadog next Tue 10:00am PT. They want a short technical demo showing end-to-end traces, token latency P95, and a couple of dashboard widgets. We need an obs checklist, a reproducible demo script, and one clean screenshot for marketing.

Michael L.: OK. Ownership? We need a staging pool (dedicated-gpu-staging), OTEL collector config that forwards to Datadog (OTLP->DD), and a dashboard template. Also confirm sampling set to 100% for the demo.

Devon T.: I can spin up the staging pool and the demo environment. Will need a config for the collector + sample spans emitted by the runtime (span names + attributes). Can someone provide a short prompt set for the flow we want to demo?

Samir P.: I’ll own the dashboard template and the one-pager ops runbook. Suggested standard span/resource attributes: `service.name=redwood-runtime`, `resource.platform=dedicated`, `host.hw_vendor=edgex`, `model.name`, `model.version`, `request.id`. Template vars: `env (staging)`, `model`, `region`. Dashboard widgets: token-latency P50/P95, trace-count, error-rate, recent traces table, and a flamegraph for model latency.

Anita R.: @Devon please include KV cache hit metric in the spans or as a metric — marketing wants to highlight cost optimization. Also we need a dry-run at 9:30am PT day-of to capture the screenshot.

Devon T.: Demo run snippet (for staging):
```bash
# demo run.sh (staging)
export OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=\"service.name=redwood-runtime,host.hw_vendor=edgex,environment=staging\"
export DD_API_KEY=REDACTED_IN_SLACK
./otelcol --config otel-collector-edgex.yaml &
python demo_infer.py --model redwood-13b --prompt-file samples/edge_prompts.txt --batch-size 8 --emit-span
```

Devon T.: Collector note: use `otlp.endpoint=https://trace.agent.datadoghq.com:443` and `exporters/otlp.headers = {"DD-API-KEY": "$DD_API_KEY"}` in the YAML. For air-gapped EdgeX appliance we’ll show a local dd-agent proxy and a cert thumbprint option.

Michael L.: Datadog contact Ryan asked for a 1-page onboarding doc for their ops team (how to connect OTLP, required headers, firewall rules). @Samir can you deliver that + the dashboard template by EOD?

Samir P.: Yep — will deliver ops runbook + dashboard by EOD. I’ll include a demo-mode dashboard that auto-refreshes and highlights traces >500ms, and a small widget that shows `kv_cache.hit_ratio`.

Anita R.: Marketing needs the announcement draft. Short form: 2 paragraphs + link to joint webinar sign-up + one screenshot. Can someone volunteer to grab the screenshot at 9:50am PT dry-run?

Devon T.: I’ll grab the screenshot during the 9:30 dry-run and upload to the shared drive. Reminder: ensure spans include `trace_id` and `model.version` so marketing's snippet can point to a measurable perf gain.

dd-demo-bot: Reminder: demo-staging deploy starting in 30m. Logs will be uploaded to `/tmp/dd-demo-logs.tar.gz` after smoke tests finish.

Michael L.: Sampling — change for demo to `always_on` in collector config; post-demo revert to parentbased/ratios. Also check trace size, we don't want to exceed Datadog ingest quota during the demo.

Samir P.: Ops note: firewall rules for EdgeX SI appliance — allow outbound to `trace.agent.datadoghq.com:443`, and if in proxy mode allow the dd-agent host. Also adding cert-thumbprint step for air-gapped onboarding.

Anita R.: Owners & timeline quick list: Devon (staging infra + screenshot), Samir (dashboard + ops runbook), Michael (collector config + DD contact), Anita (marketing draft + calendar invite). Dry-run Wed 9:30am PT, final run Tue 9:50am PT, livestream 10:00am PT.

Devon T.: Noted. I’ll open a short PR with `otel-collector-edgex.yaml` and attach sample spans/attributes.

Samir P.: Will ping Ryan D. (Datadog) with the dashboard link once it's ready.

Anita R.: Thanks — I'll create the invite and loop in EdgeX + Datadog. If anything blocks, post here and I’ll escalate. :thumbsup:
